selection: Eq. 4 and Table 2 of version 2, SM MS-bar using 2024 PDG inputs. Intermediate rows 100 TeV, 10^7 and 10^9 GeV; last row 10^16 GeV. Absolute dimensionless Yukawas and published marginal half widths. One- and two-width rectangles; no joint confidence assigned.
quantity: R=prod(y_down)/prod(y_charged_lepton), so k_down/k_lepton=R^(1/3) for 3 generations. If equal couplings are independently imposed, leave out the tau Yukawa using only the d,s,b,e,mu box. High-scale entries are linked running outputs.
models: Full nonsingular square matrices on common, calibrated input and output spaces; independent unitary cores and positive definite factors. In the spectra-only witness take k_e=1 and k_d=R^(1/3). Check actual contraction norms rather than assuming them. Competing fixed-contraction data D=d I3, E=diag(1,1,d^3) and unit-eigenvalue Jordan block illustrating the complete-matrix criterion.
